headline: OpenAI cuts GPT pricing while expanding ChatGPT capabilities
body: OpenAI reduced pricing for GPT 5.6 Sol through at least November 21 and restored usage limits for ChatGPT Plus users on Codex and Work features. The company also launched ChatGPT Search as a direct Google competitor. For healthcare AI implementations, lower inference costs directly improve economics on high-volume clinical documentation and decision support deployments, while restored feature limits signal OpenAI's focus on reliability over rapid scaling. Healthcare organizations evaluating large language models for EHR integration should monitor whether these pricing moves reshape vendor negotiations and total cost of ownership calculations for AI-powered workflows.
